source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

packed_tags.subject: science
packed_tags.topic: Mixtures, solutions, pure substances and separation

intelligence.enrichment: Substances are separated either to remove a component that is not useful or to separate different useful components from a mixture. The purpose of the task determines which component is kept, discarded, or collected separately. The learner correctly applies this rule: Substances are separated either to remove a component that is not useful or to separate different useful components from a mixture. Separation always means the removed part is the useful part.
